description: Verified exam notes for 20 November 2026 covering nuclear commissioning, an indigenous H5N1 vaccine, urban housing, IT hardware procurement, FEMA trade rules, wildlife conservation, science diplomacy, MSME AI adoption and naval capability.

stories.title: AERB permits first approach to criticality for RAPP-8
stories.summary: The Atomic Energy Regulatory Board granted permission on 19 November for the First Approach to Criticality of Rajasthan Atomic Power Project Unit 8 after reviewing its design, construction, commissioning-test results and operational preparedness. The permission is a commissioning milestone; it does not mean that commercial electricity generation has begun, which remains subject to prescribed tests and further regulatory clearances.
key_facts: RAPP-8 is the fourth unit in India's indigenously designed 700 MWe Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor series.
The unit is located at the Rawatbhata nuclear power site in Chittorgarh district, Rajasthan.
AERB will retain regulatory oversight during later commissioning stages through reviews and inspections.
stories.exam_link: Revise the role of AERB, the stages of nuclear-reactor commissioning, and the basic features of a Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor.
stories.source_title: AERB approves First Approach to Criticality of RAPP Unit-8 — PIB, 20 November 2026

stories.title: India's first indigenous H5N1 chicken vaccine dedicated to the nation
stories.summary: The Union Agriculture Minister dedicated India's first indigenous chicken vaccine against H5N1 avian influenza at ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal. The inactivated vaccine targets H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1a and is intended to strengthen poultry-disease control; the Ministry separately announced a proposed ₹300-crore animal-disease research laboratory in Bhopal.
key_facts: The vaccine was developed by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal.
H5N1 is a subtype of highly pathogenic avian influenza and can cause severe poultry mortality and trade disruption.
The announced laboratory is a future project and should not be treated as an already completed facility.
stories.exam_link: Connect the development with ICAR's research network, zoonotic diseases, avian influenza subtypes and the One Health approach.
stories.source_title: India dedicates first indigenous H5N1 bird-flu vaccine — PIB, 20 November 2026

stories.title: PMAY-U 2.0 committee sanctions 1.75 lakh urban houses
stories.summary: The Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee under PMAY-U 2.0 sanctioned 1.75 lakh houses through the Beneficiary Led Construction and Affordable Housing in Partnership verticals. Tamil Nadu received sanction for 14,350 houses. A further 1.5 lakh houses for Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra received only in-principle approval, subject to compliance and scheme guidelines.
key_facts: The latest sanction raised the total number of houses sanctioned under PMAY-U 2.0 to more than 24.15 lakh.
PMAY-U 2.0 was launched in September 2024 and targets support for one crore additional eligible urban families.
Across PMAY-U and PMAY-U 2.0, the release reported 1.29 crore houses sanctioned and 1.01 crore completed.
stories.exam_link: Revise the urban-housing mission's beneficiary groups, BLC and AHP verticals, and the distinction between sanction, in-principle approval and completion.
stories.source_title: 11th CSMC meeting under PMAY-U 2.0 — PIB, 20 November 2026

stories.title: MeitY revises domestic-value calculation for six IT hardware products
stories.summary: MeitY revised the methodology for calculating local content or domestic value addition for six IT-hardware products under the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) framework. The new Bill of Materials-based method recognises specified manufacturing processes undertaken in India, including motherboard assembly through surface-mount technology and eligible domestic sourcing and assembly activities.
key_facts: The six covered product groups are desktop or all-in-one PCs, laptops, thin clients, servers, computer monitors and interactive flat-panel displays.
The framework is process-oriented and links eligible domestic value to actual manufacturing steps and components.
The change concerns preference in public procurement and is not a general ban on imported IT hardware.
stories.exam_link: Study public procurement as an industrial-policy tool and distinguish local-content rules from customs tariffs, import licensing and production-linked incentives.
stories.source_title: MeitY revises Make in India public-procurement methodology for IT hardware — PIB, 20 November 2026

stories.title: RBI issues second amendment to 2026 foreign-trade FEMA regulations
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank issued the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026 and published explanatory FAQs. The principle-based trade regulations superseded the 2015 export regulations and took effect from 1 October 2026; RBI said the framework is intended to simplify compliance and enable authorised dealers to serve exporters and importers more efficiently.
key_facts: The 2026 framework consolidated guidance that had previously been spread across more than 150 RBI circulars.
The FAQs are only general guidance; FEMA, statutory rules, regulations, directions and permissions prevail if there is an inconsistency.
An authorised dealer is a person authorised under Section 10(1) of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999.
stories.exam_link: Revise RBI's foreign-exchange regulatory role, the purpose of FEMA 1999 and the function of authorised dealer banks in cross-border transactions.
stories.source_title: RBI issues Second Amendment Regulations for export and import of goods and services — 20 November 2026

stories.title: Four cheetah cubs born in the wild under Project Cheetah
stories.summary: A Botswana-born female cheetah, KOMG 3, gave birth to four cubs in the wild after spending more than four months under natural conditions. The Environment Ministry described it as the second recorded birth in the wild since the reintroduction programme began in 2022 and reported that India's cheetah population had risen to 62.
key_facts: The Ministry reported that 43 of the 62 cheetahs were Indian-born after the new litter.
KOMG 3 was the first female cheetah brought from Botswana to give birth in India.
A successful birth is a conservation milestone but does not by itself establish long-term population viability.
stories.exam_link: Link Project Cheetah with species reintroduction, founder populations, genetic diversity, habitat management and long-term viability assessment.
stories.source_title: Botswana-born cheetah gives birth to four cubs in the wild — PIB, 20 November 2026

stories.title: Shekhar C. Mande joins UN science and innovation group for SDGs
stories.summary: The UN Secretary-General appointed Indian National Science Academy President Professor Shekhar C. Mande to the ten-member group of high-level representatives from civil society, the private sector and the scientific community that promotes science, technology and innovation for the Sustainable Development Goals. His term runs from 2026 to 2028.
key_facts: Professor Mande is a structural and computational biologist and a former Director General of CSIR.
The group connects scientific and technological expertise with implementation of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
The appointment is to an expert group and not to a permanent intergovernmental organ of the United Nations.
stories.exam_link: Revise the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, the UN system's use of expert groups and the roles of INSA and CSIR in India's science ecosystem.
stories.source_title: INSA President appointed to UN ten-member STI group for SDGs — PIB, 20 November 2026

stories.title: AIM-backed dialogue advances AI adoption support for MSMEs
stories.summary: Microsoft India and Samhita-CGF convened an AI Enablement for MSMEs leadership dialogue alongside the Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog. The associated initiative is supporting 3,000 MSMEs across four regions through a 60-day learning programme, while a multilingual AI chatbot was unveiled. A proposed National MSME AI Adoption Playbook is still at the planning stage.
key_facts: The programme covers MSMEs in Andhra Pradesh, Delhi-NCR, Karnataka and Maharashtra.
The planned playbook is expected to draw on learning experiences from 6,000 participating individuals.
Atal Innovation Mission operates under NITI Aayog and promotes innovation and entrepreneurship.
stories.exam_link: Connect AI diffusion in MSMEs with productivity, skilling, responsible AI, digital public infrastructure and the institutional role of NITI Aayog.
stories.source_title: Putting AI to work for India's MSMEs — PIB and NITI Aayog, 20 November 2026

stories.title: Indigenously built diving support craft DSC A21 delivered to Indian Navy
stories.summary: DSC A21, Yard 326, was delivered to the Indian Navy at Naval Dockyard, Mumbai. Titagarh Rail Systems constructed the indigenously designed catamaran-hull craft, which is intended to support diving operations, underwater inspection, salvage assistance and coastal deployment.
key_facts: The Indian Register of Shipping's relevant naval rules and regulations governed the vessel's indigenous design and construction.
NSTL Visakhapatnam undertook hydrodynamic analysis and model testing during the design stage.
A catamaran uses two parallel hulls, a configuration that can improve stability and available deck area.
stories.exam_link: Revise the roles of Indian Register of Shipping and DRDO's Naval Science and Technological Laboratory, along with the operational uses of naval support craft.
stories.source_title: Delivery of DSC A21 to the Indian Navy — PIB, 20 November 2026

mcqs.question: RAPP-8 belongs to which reactor class and rated capacity?
mcqs.explanation: RAPP-8 is the fourth unit in India's indigenously designed 700 MWe PHWR series.

mcqs.question: What did AERB's permission for RAPP-8 authorise?
mcqs.explanation: The permission covered the First Approach to Criticality; later testing and approvals remain necessary before commercial operation.

mcqs.question: Which institution developed India's indigenous H5N1 chicken vaccine highlighted on 20 November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The vaccine was developed at ICAR's National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal.

mcqs.question: Tamil Nadu received sanction for how many houses in the latest PMAY-U 2.0 approval?
mcqs.explanation: The CSMC sanction included 14,350 houses for Tamil Nadu.

mcqs.question: Which PMAY-U 2.0 approvals were explicitly described as in principle and subject to compliance?
mcqs.explanation: The additional approvals for Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra were in principle, not final completed houses.

mcqs.question: MeitY's revised domestic-value methodology for IT hardware primarily uses which approach?
options: Bill of Materials and eligible processes
mcqs.explanation: The revised method is process-oriented and Bill of Materials based.

mcqs.question: Which product is among the six IT-hardware groups covered by MeitY's revised methodology?
mcqs.explanation: Servers are covered, along with PCs, laptops, thin clients, monitors and interactive flat-panel displays.

mcqs.question: The new RBI export-import regulations were issued under which principal law?
mcqs.explanation: RBI's foreign-exchange regulations operate under the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999.

mcqs.question: If RBI's FAQs conflict with a FEMA regulation, which prevails?
options: The newest bank circular regardless of authority
mcqs.explanation: RBI expressly states that the statute and binding rules, regulations, directions or permissions prevail over general-guidance FAQs.

mcqs.question: After the four new cubs, what cheetah population did the Environment Ministry report for India?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry reported a total population of 62, including 43 Indian-born cheetahs.

mcqs.question: Professor Shekhar C. Mande was appointed to a UN expert group focused on what?
options: Science, technology and innovation for the SDGs
mcqs.explanation: The ten-member group promotes science, technology and innovation in support of the Sustainable Development Goals.

mcqs.question: The AI Enablement for MSMEs initiative described by NITI Aayog supports how many enterprises?
mcqs.explanation: The initiative supports 3,000 MSMEs; 6,000 refers to individuals whose experience may inform the planned playbook.

mcqs.question: Which statement about the National MSME AI Adoption Playbook is accurate?
options: It has been enacted as a law
It is an RBI monetary instrument
mcqs.explanation: The release says the partners are planning the playbook, so it should not be described as completed.

mcqs.question: DSC A21 uses which hull configuration?
mcqs.explanation: DSC A21 has a catamaran-hull form with two parallel hulls.

mcqs.question: Which laboratory performed hydrodynamic analysis and model testing for DSC A21?
mcqs.explanation: The Naval Science and Technological Laboratory at Visakhapatnam undertook the hydrodynamic analysis and model testing.
